common.failed: Could not load this. Try again in a minute.

file.notApplied: The settings file on disk is not applied

kind.leadDetail: Lead: name, work email, company; to Audience and CRM
kind.contactDetail: Contact: name, email, message; to Helpdesk
kind.npsDetail: NPS: a score and a reason; to Audience
kind.surveyDetail: Short survey: a rating and a comment

partials.off: nothing is kept of answers not sent
partials.progress: how far people got is kept, not what they wrote
partials.answers: what people wrote so far is kept

type.textCheck: Up to 300 characters, or the min and max the file sets; a pattern if it has one
type.textareaCheck: Up to 5,000 characters, or the max the file sets
type.emailCheck: An address with a name, an @ and a domain
type.phoneCheck: 7 to 15 digits, with spaces, dashes, brackets or a + allowed
type.numberCheck: A number between the min and max the file sets
type.choicesCheck: Any of the options, as many as min and max allow
type.ratingCheck: 1 to 5 stars, or up to max
type.scaleCheck: A whole number from min to max
type.fileCheck: PDF, PNG or JPEG by default, up to 5 MB; its bytes must be the type it says
type.consentCheck: Unticked is no and is never recorded; a ticked box is recorded in Consent with its text
type.statementCheck: Shown as text; nothing to answer

forms.title: Forms
forms.description: Every form with its answers this week and where they went. Each form is a file, reviewed like code.
forms.newDetail: It starts as a draft in this browser, with the fields every form of its kind needs. It is live once its file is committed.
forms.name: Name
forms.taken: forms/{{id}}.yaml is taken; choose another name.
forms.ofViewsDetail: Answers as a share of the times the form was shown
forms.consentDetail: of answers to forms with a box, ticked
forms.none: No forms yet. Add one with New form, or write it in forms.yaml.

form.missingDetail: It is not in the settings file, or its file has a mistake. See Settings.
form.draftDetail: Changes here are a draft. Save them as YAML and commit the file; the live form changes once Forms reads it, within a minute.
form.fileDetail: This is the form as its file has it. Changes here are a draft until you save them as YAML and commit the file.
form.yamlDetail: Commit this file. Forms reads it within a minute and says on Settings what it could not apply.
form.requiredDetail: The form cannot be sent without it
form.hiddenFields: Hidden fields, filled from the address: {{names}}.
form.question: Question
form.consentLinked: Recorded in Consent as {{purpose}}, {{channels}}, text v{{version}}
form.consentNotLinked: Consent is not linked: a ticked box is kept in Forms only
form.consentDetail: The text next to the box comes from Consent, so it is the one Consent keeps as proof.
form.previewDetail: As a visitor sees it; nothing is sent from here
form.previewFailed: The draft cannot be drawn; check it in Save as YAML.

logic.rulesDetail: A rule shows a field or a page only when an earlier answer holds.
logic.none: No rules: every field is shown.
logic.noEarlier: There is no earlier question with options for this field to depend on.
logic.ownerByDetail: The CRM deal goes to the member each answer names.
logic.shortDetail: Rules show or skip fields and pages from earlier answers. Jumping back, scoring quizzes and long branching surveys are not part of Forms.

share.embedDetail: One script tag; the form is drawn in your page, with your page's font and colours.
share.pageDetail: The form's own page, for a link in a message or an ad.
share.origins: It can be embedded on {{origins}}, as the form's embed list says.
share.noOrigins: It can be embedded only on sites the form's embed list names; add yours under forms.{{id}}.embed.
share.analytics: With Analytics' script on the page, views and answers count as the events form_view and form_submit with form {{id}}; nothing typed is read.
share.prefilledDetail: Fill fields and hidden fields from the address, for a link in a message or an ad.
share.campaignHint: Campaigns makes these links by its naming rules.

routing.title: Where answers go
routing.detail: An answer goes where its form says. With a product not linked, it stays in Forms.
routing.audience: Adds or updates the person's profile, with form_submitted on their timeline; traits: {{traits}}
routing.crm: Finds or creates the contact and company, and opens a deal where CRM's leads start
routing.crmOwner: Finds or creates the contact and company, and opens a deal for {{owner}}
routing.crmBy: Finds or creates the contact and company, and opens a deal for the owner the answer to {{field}} names
routing.consent: A ticked box is recorded as {{purpose}}, {{channels}}, with text v{{version}}; unticked is no
routing.helpdesk: Opens a ticket from the person's email, for routing rules with form {{form}}
routing.mail: An email to {{to}}, with reply-to the person
routing.webhook: POST, signed as Standard Webhooks signs, tried again for three days
routing.captcha: With the {{provider}} check from the file.
routing.honeypot: A hidden field people never see, which bots fill
routing.fast: Sent less than {{s}} seconds after the page opened
routing.rate: More than {{rate}} answers from one address
routing.pow: A proof of work of {{bits}} bits, found while people type
routing.held: {{n}} answers held this week; see Answers, Spam.
routing.draftDetail: Where its answers go is shown once its file is committed and read.

answers.title: Answers
answers.description: One form's answers, where each went, and what was held as spam. Answers are kept in your install.
answers.searchPlaceholder: Name, company, email or an answer
answers.more: {{n}} more; narrow the search or export them.
answers.ticked: Ticked next to text v{{version}} of {{purpose}}:
answers.notTicked: Not ticked. Messages will not send this person offers.
answers.keptHere: Nowhere: the form sends to no linked product.
answers.markedSpam: Marked as spam; what was waiting is not sent.
answers.deleted: The answer and its files are deleted.

partialDetail.off: This form keeps nothing of answers not sent.
partialDetail.progress: People who started and stopped: how far they got, never what they wrote. Sent nowhere, and deleted after the time keep.partials sets.
partialDetail.answers: People who started and stopped, with what they wrote so far. Sent nowhere, and deleted after the time keep.partials sets.

answers.spamDetail: Never sent anywhere. Mark one as not spam and it is sent where its form says.
answers.notSpamDone: {{name}}'s answer is not spam: it is sent where its form says.
answers.noFormsDetail: Add a form under Forms, or write one in forms.yaml.
answers.goneDetail: It was deleted, or the link is wrong.

went.consent: Recorded as consent, with the text shown

spamWhy.tooFast: Sent too soon after the page opened

results.title: Results
results.description: How far people get in a form, what they answer, and NPS over time.
results.stopDetail: People who reached each field, last 7 days
results.leave: {{n}} of the {{of}} people who started stopped on {{page}}
results.leaveDetail: Fewer questions on that page, or making some optional, is worth a try.
results.many: More than one may be picked
results.reasonsDetail: The answer given after the score

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: The products answers go to, as forms.yaml links them. A product not linked is hidden from the forms, and answers stay in Forms.
integrations.consent: Ticked consent boxes are recorded there, with the text shown next to them.
integrations.audience: Each answer adds or updates the person's profile.
integrations.crm: Lead forms open a contact and a deal.
integrations.mail: Emails to the people a form names.
integrations.secretMissing: {{name}} is not set: nothing is sent.
integrations.webhooksDetail: Each answer as JSON, signed as Standard Webhooks signs.
integrations.analyticsDetail: Its script on the form pages counts views and answers, never what is typed.
integrations.audienceErasureDetail: When a person is deleted in Audience, it asks Forms to delete their answers.
integrations.apiDetail: Your own forms can send answers through the same API the form pages use.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Forms, spam filters, what is kept and the links to other products, as {{file}} and the forms folder set them.
settings.readOnlyDetail: Change them in the file and review the change like code; Forms reads it again within a minute. A file with a mistake leaves the last good version in place.
settings.noFile: No settings file: no forms, and the defaults are in use.
settings.answersDetail: Kept in your install; partial answers are never sent anywhere.
settings.formsDetail: Each form's own spam filters and partial answers.
settings.formValue: {{kind}}; under {{s}} s is too fast, {{rate}} from one address; {{partials}}
settings.captchaOn: With the {{provider}} check on forms that ask it.
settings.rolesValue: Viewers see answers and results; editors mark spam, send again and delete answers; admins manage members and tokens. Forms change only in their files.

auth.accountDetail: Your name, password and second factors.
auth.membersDetail: Who works in Forms, and their role: viewers see answers, editors also mark spam, send again and delete, admins manage members and tokens.
auth.signinDetail: How people sign in: passwords, and identity providers over OIDC.
auth.tokensDetail: Tokens for scripts and other products, each with one role and an expiry. Audience needs an admin token to delete answers.
